posts.title: Welcome to the golden age of computational complexity theory
posts.description: Since the beginning of the field complexity theory had to put up with humiliation; all could be proved were things like Parity not in AC0, with essentially zero impact on reality and deployed systems. posts.title: VP != VNP: “I do not complain, the antelope falls with the arrow”
posts.description: It was just announced a proof of the most famous open problem in algebraic complexity: VP is not equal to VNP: https://github.com/anthropics/formal-math/blob/main/vp-vnp/paper.pdf The human-readable part of the paper is very short and mostly points to the Lean formalization.
